I couldn't find a name for Driftmoor's night-dispatch contact. The brain notes say engineering gave their night dispatcher a manual CSV patch for the tide-table import, but they don't name the dispatcher. The only night dispatcher I found is Hector at the Beaumont barge slip, and that's Pellucid Harbor Logistics, a different account, so I wouldn't send the patch to him.

Kwame is the best person to ask, since the Driftmoor account is his. I can't see his direct messages with anyone else, so I can't check there. If you give me the name, I can help with the note itself.
